sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000131-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Highland Pediatric Center 131 on February 15, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 4%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Hepatitis share floor of 80%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
